::: {.remark .notes}

The range of $X$ is the [image](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/relations.html#def-image) of $X$ as a function on $\samplespace$.
For a general function, these notes say "image",
because some sources use "range" for the codomain instead;
for a random variable, "range" is the standard term.

:::
